description: Moves the toolhead in a straight line to the given position, optionally extruding while it goes.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: Target position on the X axis.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: Target position on the Y axis.

parameters.name: Z
parameters.description: Target position on the Z axis.

parameters.name: E
parameters.description: Filament to push or pull over the move.

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Feed rate, in millimetres per minute.

description: Sets the hotend target temperature and returns at once.

parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Target temperature in degrees Celsius; 0 switches the heater off.

description: Runs mesh bed levelling over a limited area, which slicers set to the printed footprint.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: Centre of the area on X.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: Centre of the area on Y.

description: Tells the firmware how much filament weight the print has used so far, for the filament-left display.
Sets a secondary cooler or heatbreak target temperature in files for newer Prusa printers (exact meaning unverified).
Tells the multi-material unit which filament type is loaded in an extruder slot.
Gives the bounding box of the print so the firmware limits its bed probing and purge to that area.
Sets pressure advance for the extruder.

parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Pressure advance time in seconds; 0 switches it off.

description: Configures input shaping, which cancels vibration in the given axis.

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Resonance frequency in Hz; 0 means the default.

description: Unloads the filament from the hotend.
Checks that the printer nozzle diameter matches the sliced file and warns otherwise.

parameters.name: A
parameters.description: Whether to abort on a mismatch (unverified).

description: Checks that the printer model matches the model the file was sliced for.

parameters.name: P
parameters.description: Expected printer model name, in quotes.

description: Checks that the printer supports the G-code level the file needs.
Checks that the printer firmware has a feature the file needs.
